title: Little gourd (Kundru): modeled ₹871/qtl left, Kattappana → Surat
summary: March 2024: reported little gourd (Kundru) prices at Kattappana and Surat imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 20 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹871 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 158 same-variety market pairs screened for little gourd (Kundru) in March 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Surat report 4–6 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: March 2024
scenes.caption: Kattappana (Kerala) and Surat (Gujarat) both reported little gourd (Kundru) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 20 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kattappana reported a median ₹3,450 per quintal. Surat reported a median ₹5,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,575/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,575 per quintal, and Surat was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 1,706 km by road
scenes.caption: 1,706 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~22 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 4 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹367/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹711 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹354 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Surat report, the rule selects 20 of 20 modeled shipping days. 20 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹871 per quintal (₹518 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Little gourd (Kundru) route from Kattappana to Surat was positive on 100% of matched days in March 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹87,100, or ₹51,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to little gourd (Kundru)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹367/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 4 days here

conclusion: The modeled Little gourd (Kundru) route from Kattappana to Surat was positive on 100% of matched days in March 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹87,100, or ₹51,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
